qAndA.answer: Wrestler 1 isolates Wrestler 2's arm by grabbing his shoulder, then passes his own leg over Wrestler 2's arm to trap it.

qAndA.answer: Wrestler 1 demonstrates a powerful, swinging punch.

qAndA.answer: Wrestler 1 uses his elbow on Wrestler 2's hip and his hand on Wrestler 2's shoulder to continue controlling the arm.
qAndA.question: How does Wrestler 1 maintain control of Wrestler 2's arm even if it is partially free?

activities.description: Wrestler 1 secures a side control position and passes Wrestler 2's guard.
Wrestler 1 traps Wrestler 2's arm by isolating it and passing his leg over.
Wrestler 1 maintains control of Wrestler 2's arm and transitions to a crucifix position.
Wrestler 1 demonstrates throwing a large punch from the crucifix position.
Wrestler 1 emphasizes control of the arm and demonstrates strikes with his free arm.
Wrestler 1 transitions to a modified side control, maintaining arm control and demonstrating more strikes.

characterInteraction.description: Wrestler 1 is the experienced instructor teaching and guiding Wrestler 2 through the technique. The interaction is respectful and focused on learning.

text_to_speech: I put much into the opponent's side take the underhook by grabbing his shoulder sit out and past the guards make sure you stay tight and push his arm with your body my main purpose here is to get his arm out of the way controlling him with the underhook from the one side and my hips from the other I throw my leg leg over and trappings arm if you have a chance to grab his wrist and pull it you'll have even more control over his arm because you'll have it extended more now he can defend himself only with his free arm I grabbed him by the wrist and push it I have much better leverage here it's almost like bench press here once I push this with forward I get my head through and end up in the crucifix position important point the higher you swing up the heavier your punch will be some people think is better to use short punches from this position but this big punch is really effective here you can use various elbow strikes here as well if they illegal make sure you always keep the control of his arm with your legs if he gets his left arm out just keep holding him with your elbow on his hip and with your hand on the shoulder stay on him and look for the opportunity you can follow up with the submission or trapping his left arm again and throwing strikes on him [Music] again big punches are really effective here

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I put my shin to the opponent's thigh, take the underhook by grabbing his shoulder, sit
out and pass the guard.
Make sure you stay tight and push his arm with your body.
My main purpose here is to get his arm out of the weight, controlling him with the underhook
from the one side and my hips from the other, I throw my leg leg over and trap his arm.
If you have a chance to grab his wrist and pull it, you'll have even more control over
his arm because you'll have it extended more.
Now he can defend himself only with his free arm.
I grab him by the wrist and push it.
I have much better leverage here, it's almost like bench press here.
Once I push his wrist forward, I get my head through and end up in the crucifix position.
Important point, the higher you swing up, the heavier your punch will be.
Some people think it's better to use short punches from this position, but this big punch
is really effective here.
You can use various elbow strikes here as well if they are legal.
Make sure you always keep the control of his arm with your legs.
If he gets his left arm out, just keep holding him with your elbow on his hip and with
your hand on his shoulder.
Stay on him and look for the opportunities.
You can follow up with the submission or trapping his left arm again and throwing strikes on him.
Again, big punches are really effective here.
